responsibility: Implements interprocedural scalar replacement of aggregates and related signature cleanup. It summarizes parameter and return-value usage, aggregate field accesses, call argument flow, and transformation constraints; performs SCC-based IPA propagation to decide parameter removal, splitting, by-reference-to-by-value replacement, and unused return removal; and records clone/signature adjustments for later materialization by the parameter-manipulation machinery. This is the analysis and decision pass for IPA-SRA, not the body-rewrite engine itself.
